Definition: Pelajah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Pelaiah = "Jehovah does wonders"; 1) son of Elioenai and a descendant of David in the royal line; 2) a priest who helped Ezra to expound the law to the people and also sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
